newsitem.title: USA: Ugly Duckling underwriters exercise option.
newsitem.headline: Ugly Duckling underwriters exercise option.

text.p: Ugly Duckling Corp on Friday said that the underwriters for the company's recent public offering have exercised their overallotment option to buy an additional 600,000 shares at $15 per share.
The managing underwriters for the October 1996 offering of four million shares were Freedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc. and Cruttenden Roth Inc, Ugly Duckling said.
The public offering was also priced at $15 per share.
Net proceeds to the company from the exercise of the option were approximately $8.5 million, increasing total net proceeds from the offering to approximately $64.5 million.
Ugly Duckling is a used-car sales and finance company.
